description: This file defines the 'BuzzDetailedCommentModel' class in the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin module. It models detailed information about a buzz comment, including comment metadata, employee info, sharing info, and permissions. It implements serialization via the Normalizable interface and uses a trait for Buzz service functions.

classes.name: BuzzDetailedCommentModel
classes.description: A model class representing the detailed structure of a Buzz comment, including embedded employee info, permissions, and share data. Designed for serialization via the Normalizable interface.

methods.description: Constructor method initializing the model with a BuzzComment entity.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the BuzzComment and related info into an associative array for external use or API responses.
